conclusions: Unknowns remain explicit: respondent-level overlap across surveys is unknown; CES case IDs establish uniqueness only within that source; calibration sample identity, publication time and historical version are unresolved; official source byte/vintage authentication is incomplete; shared 2020 cycle dependence remains.

The validator rejects unresolved dependence and historical time claims in synthetic examples, but does not admit the actual inventory as a complete Problem or historical replay. Hardening-v2 success remains unauthenticated and not fit-authorized.
No material inconsistency found in the reviewed counts or pin list. The inventory remains a provenance audit with substantial scientific and source-authentication work outstanding.
limitations: No source authenticity adjudication, respondent crosswalk, complete M01 Problem/vector binding, fundamentals label-use ledger, predictive evaluation, or model fit was performed.
Inventory hashes authenticate the inspected bytes against listed digests, not the underlying source claims or their original publication/vintage.
